candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije – Register subjektov nadzora (register of supervised entities)
candidates.why_relevant: Master searchable index of all entities supervised by the central bank (~372 records: banks, savings banks, payment institutions, e-money institutions, bureaux de change, credit intermediaries). This is the definitive universe of Slovenian licensed money-movers, i.e. the buyer universe for the tender/procurement cells.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic HTML scrape of the register search result pages; snapshot entity names + license type into the actor master list; monthly cadence
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search + fetch of regulator site
queries_used: Banka Slovenije register plačilnih institucij družb za izdajo elektronskega denarja seznam
Bank of Slovenia register payment institutions list

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije – Register družb za izdajo elektronskega denarja (e-money institutions register)
candidates.why_relevant: Statutory register under ZPlaSSIED of licensed e-money issuers, their agents and branches, plus incoming EEA passport notifications. Identifies non-bank issuers who procure card/wallet/processing technology.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape page + linked PDF/XLS registers; diff against prior snapshot to detect new entrants
queries_used: Banka Slovenije register plačilnih institucij družb za izdajo elektronskega denarja seznam

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije – Nadzor nebančnih ponudnikov plačilnih storitev in infrastruktur finančnega trga
candidates.why_relevant: Hub page from which the payment-institution, PISP/AISP and payment-system-operator lists hang; also names supervised FMI operators (e.g. payment system operators) that run large procurement.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl one level deep from this hub; harvest all child register pages
queries_used: Banka Slovenije register ponudnikov storitev odreditve plačil storitev informiranja o računih AISP PISP

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije – Plačilne institucije držav EGP v Sloveniji (EEA payment institutions passporting into SI)
candidates.why_relevant: Lists foreign EEA payment institutions active in Slovenia — competitors/partners not visible in the domestic licence list, and potential bidders in bank-side sourcing.
queries_used: Banka Slovenije register plačilnih institucij družb za izdajo elektronskega denarja seznam

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije – Register kreditnih posrednikov / ponudnikov finančnega zakupa / serviserjev kreditov
candidates.why_relevant: Adjacent statutory registers (credit intermediaries, real-estate leasing providers, NPL credit servicers) discovered on the supervised-entities page; these firms buy collection, onboarding and KYC technology.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape each register page; low frequency (semi-annual)
candidates.discovered_via_method: fetched register-subjektov-nadzora page and read outbound links

candidates.why_relevant: Authoritative membership list of the Bank Association of Slovenia — member banks, savings banks and leasing companies. Directly enumerates the Slovenian bank buyer universe for tenders and RFPs.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape member list page (sl + /en/); reconcile names against AJPES legal entities; quarterly
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query then fetch of site navigation
queries_used: Združenje bank Slovenije seznam članic

candidates.source_name: ZBS – Organiziranost / committees and working bodies
candidates.why_relevant: Committee and working-group structure names the bank staff who own payments, cards, IT security and compliance agendas — the people who define requirements before a tender is published.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual scrape; note GDPR care on named individuals
queries_used: Združenje bank Slovenije seznam članic

candidates.why_relevant: Association-published banking journal; articles reveal projects, vendors and modernisation programmes months before procurement, and identify subject-matter owners inside member banks.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Harvest article metadata/abstracts only; respect paywall on full texts
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball via National Payments Council search
queries_used: Nacionalni svet za plačila Banka Slovenije člani sestava

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije – Nacionalni svet za plačila (National Payments Council), membership and session minutes
candidates.why_relevant: Multi-stakeholder council whose membership list enumerates the umbrella organisations of the Slovenian payment market (central bank, Bankart, ZBS, GZS, ministries, AML office). Published minutes name the institutions and the initiatives that later become procurement.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape page + download session minutes PDFs; extract attendee organisations into actor map
queries_used: Nacionalni svet za plačila Banka Slovenije člani sestava

candidates.source_name: GZS – Združenje za informatiko in telekomunikacije (ZIT), Članstvo
candidates.why_relevant: The chamber's ICT association — the supply side. Its membership/board pages enumerate the Slovenian IT vendors and integrators most likely to bid on bank and public-sector payment tenders.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape membership + Upravni odbor pages and the ZIT catalogues (KATALOGI) section; note some member data may be behind chamber login
queries_used: GZS Združenje za informatiko in telekomunikacije seznam članov

candidates.source_name: GZS – Zbornica / sectoral association directory (26 sectoral associations)
candidates.why_relevant: Umbrella chamber index: from here the finance-adjacent and ICT sectoral associations (and their member directories) can be enumerated, giving a broad supplier-side actor map beyond ZIT.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl association index, then each association's members/board page
queries_used: GZS Združenje za informatiko in telekomunikacije seznam članov

candidates.source_name: Slovenska digitalna koalicija – digitalna.si (working groups and partners)
candidates.why_relevant: GZS-coordinated multi-stakeholder digitalisation coalition; its working-group (delovne skupine) and project pages name participating companies and public bodies, including the blockchain/fintech cluster, i.e. a cross-sector actor index.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape delovne-skupine and projekti pages; extract organisation names
queries_used: fintech Slovenija združenje seznam podjetij Digitalna koalicija
"digitalna koalicija" podpisniki člani seznam digitalna.si partnerji

candidates.why_relevant: Slovenian-registered blockchain/crypto industry association; membership overlaps heavily with the domestic fintech/crypto-payments vendor pool.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape members page; cross-check each member in AJPES for legal identity
queries_used: Slovenia fintech association list of members "Blockchain Alliance" OR "FinTech" Slovenija

candidates.source_name: SBCA – Slovenian Blockchain Association / Slovensko blockchain združenje
candidates.why_relevant: Second Slovenian blockchain/crypto association; useful for completing the crypto-payments actor universe and for cross-referencing with Blockchain Alliance membership.
queries_used: Slovenia fintech association list of members "Blockchain Alliance" OR "FinTech" Slovenija

candidates.source_name: AJPES ePRS – Poslovni register Slovenije (Slovenian Business Register)
candidates.why_relevant: The national company register: lets any association/regulator member name be resolved to a legal entity, and lets the actor universe be expanded by SKD activity code (e.g. 62.01 computer programming, 64.19 banking, 66.19 auxiliary financial services). Open-data bulk copy exists on OPSI.
candidates.legal_status: public_official_register; reuse conditions published by AJPES
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Prefer the OPSI open-data dump of PRS over scraping ePRS; use ePRS interactively for one-off lookups; check AJPES 'Ponovna uporaba' reuse terms
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search for activity-code company lists
queries_used: AJPES ePRS Poslovni register Slovenije iskanje po SKD dejavnosti 62.01 seznam podjetij

candidates.source_name: OPSI – Informativni seznam naročnikov po Zakonu o javnem naročanju (official list of contracting authorities)
candidates.why_relevant: The statutory index of every entity that must procure under ZJN-3 — the definitive buyer list for the A2 tender workstream, obtained as structured open data rather than scraped notice by notice.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Download dataset resource directly via OPSI API/CSV; refresh on dataset update
queries_used: eJN portal javnih naročil seznam naročnikov register naročnikov Slovenija

candidates.source_name: OPSI – Seznam aktualnih javnih naročil v informacijskem sistemu e-JN
candidates.why_relevant: Open-data index of live tenders in the e-JN system, each row carrying the contracting authority name — a machine-readable pointer that links the buyer register to actual tender activity.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the dataset resource (CSV/JSON) daily; join authority names to the naročniki register
queries_used: eJN portal javnih naročil seznam naročnikov register naročnikov Slovenija

candidates.source_name: ATVP – Registri (securities market registers: investment firms, tied agents, public companies)
candidates.why_relevant: Securities-market regulator's statutory registers complete the financial-sector actor universe beyond banking/payments (brokerages, fund managers, listed issuers), all of which run IT and compliance procurement.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape each register index page semi-annually
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search (inferred category: other financial regulators)
queries_used: ATVP register borznoposredniških družb seznam nadzorovanih subjektov

candidates.source_name: EBA central register of payment and e-money institutions under PSD2 (filterable to SI)
candidates.why_relevant: EU-level mirror of the national payment/e-money registers, downloadable in bulk — a cross-check on the Banka Slovenije lists and a way to catch inbound passporting firms. Note it excludes credit institutions by design.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Download full register export, filter home/host country = SI; monthly
queries_used: EBA credit institutions register PSD2 payment institutions register search Slovenia

negative_findings.description: No dedicated Slovenian fintech industry association with a published member directory was found. Searches in sl and en surfaced only blockchain/crypto associations (Blockchain Alliance Europe, SBCA) and commercial startup databases (Tracxn, ensun, startuprise) rather than a national 'Fintech Slovenija' body.
negative_findings.result_summary: Fintech actor universe for SI must be assembled from regulator registers + AJPES SKD codes + blockchain associations, not from a single association member list.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Downstream cells cannot assume an association roster exists for fintech vendors; entity discovery has to be register-driven.

negative_findings.description: GZS ZIT (ICT association) publishes its board (upravni odbor) and catalogue sections, but a complete public member list was not located in search results; membership data may sit behind the chamber's member area.
negative_findings.result_summary: Board membership retrievable; full roster unverified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Supply-side (bidder) enumeration via the chamber may be partial; AJPES SKD-code extraction is the fallback.

negative_findings.description: Slovenska digitalna koalicija (digitalna.si) does not appear to publish a consolidated signatories/members list; participation is visible only indirectly through working-group and project pages.
negative_findings.result_summary: No single roster page found in sl or en searches.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Coalition membership must be reconstructed by crawling working groups, which is noisier and needs deduplication.

negative_findings.description: AJPES ePRS requires free registration/login for the interactive application, and AJPES publishes separate reuse ('ponovna uporaba') conditions for bulk PRS data.
negative_findings.result_summary: Bulk collection should go through the OPSI open-data dataset or AJPES's paid/registered report service, not through scraping the logged-in ePRS UI.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents a compliance problem in the collection layer for the single most useful entity-resolution source.

negative_findings.description: All URLs in this slice were recorded from search results and, where fetched, from live page content; none has been independently verified as reachable by this agent, and no page returned an error during this run. bsi.si register subpages have long, versioned paths that historically get reorganised.
negative_findings.result_summary: Treat deep bsi.si and a-tvp.si paths as hypotheses; fall back to the section hub page on 404.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Avoids marking live-but-moved registers as dead.

coverage_gaps.description: The specific PISP/AISP (storitev odreditve plačil / storitev informiranja o računih) register listing was not isolated to a single stable URL; it appears to live under the supervised-entities register search rather than on its own page.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch https://www.bsi.si/sl/nadzor-bancnega-sistema/register-subjektov-nadzora and enumerate the entity-type filter values to locate the PISP/AISP subset URL/query parameters.

coverage_gaps.description: Insurance-sector registers (AZN – Agencija za zavarovalni nadzor) and the insurance association (Slovensko zavarovalno združenje) were not searched in this run; insurers are significant procurers of payment/IT technology.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run sl queries: 'AZN register zavarovalnic seznam', 'Slovensko zavarovalno združenje članice'.

coverage_gaps.description: Payment-infrastructure operators (Bankart d.o.o. as card/processing operator, Bankart/BS scheme participant lists, SEPA scheme adherence lists) were seen only as NSP attendees; their participant/member lists were not harvested.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search 'Bankart udeleženci seznam bank', 'SEPA scheme adherence list Slovenia', and check the EPC register of SEPA scheme participants filtered to SI.

coverage_gaps.description: Slovene-language searching was performed for every category in this cell, but no Italian/Hungarian minority-language or Croatian-language variants were attempted, and English coverage was limited to EU-level registers.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add en-language passes on bsi.si/en and a-tvp.si English mirrors to capture English official names for entity matching.

coverage_gaps.description: No register of qualified/registered suppliers (bidders) for Slovenian public procurement was identified; e-JN appears to expose contracting authorities and notices but not a public supplier directory.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Investigate whether e-JN or enarocanje.si exposes award-notice winner data that can be aggregated into a de-facto supplier register; also check TED (EU) SI award notices.

brief: Slovenia's actor universe for banking and payments is unusually well indexed by official registers: Banka Slovenije runs a single searchable 'register subjektov nadzora' (~372 supervised entities) plus dedicated statutory registers for e-money institutions, EEA passporting firms, credit intermediaries and NPL servicers, and ATVP covers the securities side. On the demand side, Združenje bank Slovenije publishes an explicit member list of banks, savings banks and leasing companies, and the Nacionalni svet za plačila minutes name the umbrella organisations of the payment market. Supply-side (bidder) enumeration is weaker: GZS ZIT publishes only its board rather than a full roster, no national fintech association with a member directory was found, and the practical fallback is AJPES/OPSI business-register extraction by SKD activity code. For the A2 tender workstream the highest-value pointers are the OPSI open-data 'informativni seznam naročnikov' under ZJN-3 (the definitive buyer list) and the e-JN active-tenders dataset, which join cleanly to the regulator and association rosters.
